translations.web: For my eyes are on you, Yahweh, the Lord. In you, I take refuge. Don’t leave my soul destitute.
translations.bsb: But my eyes are fixed on You, O GOD the Lord. In You I seek refuge; do not leave my soul defenseless.
translations.kjv: But mine eyes are unto thee, O GOD the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.
translations.asv: For mine eyes are unto thee, O Jehovah the Lord: In thee do I take refuge; leave not my soul destitute.
